The '''Trackmaster''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Praxon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Praxon Trackmaster was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was added to the game in Game Update 2.1.1 as a purchasable item from the reputation vendor on [[Voss]].<ref name="2.1.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.1.1/5302013|text=Game Update 2.1.1 Patch Notes}}</ref>
